from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fb0fd12a.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] for r in range(len(grid)))]
    r0, r1 = rows[0], rows[-1] + 1
    c0, c1 = cols[0], cols[-1] + 1
    height, width = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [row[c0:c0 + width // 2] for row in grid[r0:r0 + height // 2]]
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'))
